connectivity.producer: Owner-published D1 version policy names the exact allowed recommended target while existing authorization data binds license and device
connectivity.transport: Worker update-ticket reads the same D1 license, device and version-policy authority without requiring a runtime session
connectivity.consumer: A revoked client keeps only the update UI and can request the allowed target; task execution remains denied by the existing runtime gate
connectivity.ordering: License and device validation -> target equals allowed recommendation -> ticket issuance; the current revoked version is not treated as permission to run and is not used to deny recovery download

proves: Version revocation continues to deny runtime while preserving a narrow recovery-update path

connectivity.producer: Prod signs the exact accepted Gamma manifest and package identity
connectivity.transport: Worker returns the signed manifest and a bounded short-lived R2 URL; client downloads into its existing staging directory
connectivity.consumer: Pinned-key ClientUpdatePackage and existing external installer verify, switch the stable pointer and restart only after user confirmation
connectivity.ordering: Ticket -> manifest signature -> bounded package download -> SHA256/size -> exit confirmation -> parent exit and lock -> atomic version pointer -> restart

proves: Changing storage does not weaken signature, hash, parent-exit or atomic-pointer installation boundaries

connectivity.producer: Accepted exact Gamma promotion signs the unchanged package and uploads package plus signed manifest to immutable versioned private R2 keys
connectivity.transport: Private R2 objects, D1 exact object identity and revision, authenticated HTTPS update-ticket, short-lived R2 presigned download URL
connectivity.consumer: Client automatically uses a Windows-DPAPI-protected prior successful license, verifies the signed manifest with its pinned public key, verifies package hash/size, then uses the existing external installer
connectivity.ordering: Gamma accepted -> sign exact bytes -> R2 upload -> remote object verification -> D1 CAS announcement -> user clicks update -> automatic credential submission -> update-ticket -> direct R2 download -> signature/hash verification -> user exit confirmation -> install/restart; never announce before object verification and never require runtime session for an update ticket

proves: Private GitHub is not a client dependency after bridge migration
Unlicensed or device-mismatched clients receive no download ticket
A revoked current version can still download only the allowed recommended target
R2 URL and authorization material never become an installation trust decision

businessDifference.conflictSummary: Replace public GitHub release downloads with licensed private R2 distribution while preserving exact-Gamma promotion and signed-install trust.
